Establish infrastructure standards, reference designs, and lifecycle and refresh plans; manage technical debt and retire legacy systems. Evaluate emerging technologies and make recommendations to leadership on infrastructure investments, including automation and AI-enabled operations. Produce and maintain authoritative network diagrams, IP and VLAN design, firewall rule sets, and configuration standards. Operations, reliability, and resilience Ensure high availability of the infrastructure that supports warehouse, distribution, and fleet operations, including coverage across docks, cold storage, and production areas where downtime delays food reaching neighbors. Define, measure, and report service levels for uptime, incident response, and change success; lead incident, problem, and change management using ITIL practices. Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, including backup, recovery objectives, and at least annual testing. Maintain current documentation, network diagrams, runbooks, and an on-call model so no single person is a point of failure. Cybersecurity and risk Share accountability for the Food Depository's cybersecurity program with the Director of IT Support, each leading the controls closest to their domain. Own infrastructure security architecture and operations: network and perimeter security, firewalls, segmentation, remote access, cloud and identity architecture, conditional access, infrastructure vulnerability and patch management, and security monitoring. Partner with the Director of IT Support on endpoint protection, user access, device compliance, and security awareness, so controls are consistent from the network edge to every Foodbanker's device. Maintain the infrastructure portion of a security program aligned to NIST CSF or CIS Controls, and report risk posture and remediation progress to IT leadership. Support audits, cyber insurance requirements, and the security obligations of government programs, funders, and payment processing. Translate findings from third-party security assessments into prioritized, time-bound remediation plans with clear owners. Financial and vendor management Build business cases, total cost of ownership analyses, and multi-year refresh plans that inform infrastructure investment decisions by the VP of Technology and Infrastructure, who owns the budget. Negotiate vendor agreements and hold partners accountable to contracted commitments. Leadership and team development Lead, hire, and develop infrastructure staff, apprentices, and contractors; set clear goals and hold the team to a high standard of service. Build bench strength through cross-training, mentoring, and professional development. Partner as a peer with the Director of IT Support, and with Applications and CRM leaders, to deliver an integrated, Foodbanker-centered technology experience, with clear handoffs between infrastructure and End User Services. Cross-functional partnership Partner with Operations, Facilities, Finance, and program teams to plan technology for facility projects, new or expanded sites, and changes in operations.
